title: Training an unbeatable AI in Trackmania
summary: Yosh trains a reinforcement learning agent to drive Trackmania until he can no longer beat it. The video explains how the training works and the design choices involved.
why: Recommended as an approachable explanation of how reinforcement learning works in practice, and cited for the constraints needed to stop exploits.

quote.text: be sure to check out the videos by Yosh. They're amazing, and do a great job explaining how reinforcement learning works in practice
